blocks.en: We now consider a general system of partial differential equations, for which we shall prescribe initial data on a noncharacteristic surface. We shall demonstrate how such a problem can be reduced to the form given by \eqref{eq:ck-intro-quasilinear-system}, \eqref{eq:ck-intro-zero-initial-data}. First, we reduce the initial surface to a plane.
blocks.zh: 现在考虑一般的偏微分方程组, 在一个非特征曲面上指定初始数据. 将说明如何把这样的问题化为 \eqref{eq:ck-intro-quasilinear-system}, \eqref{eq:ck-intro-zero-initial-data} 所给的形式. 首先将初始曲面化为平面.

blocks.en: We say that a surface is of class $C^k$, $k\geq1$ (analytic) if, respectively, the functions $\phi$, $\psi$, $\bm{F}$ are of class $C^k$ (analytic). The implicit function theorem implies that locally all three definitions are equivalent. After possible renumbering of coordinates, we may therefore assume that an analytic surface is given in the form $x_n=\psi(x_1,\ldots,x_{n-1})$, where $\psi$ is analytic. We now set $y_i=x_i$ for $i\leq n-1$ and $y_n=x_n-\psi(x_1,\ldots,x_{n-1})$. In the new coordinates the initial surface is $y_n=0$. Henceforth we shall therefore assume that the initial surface is the plane $x_n=0$.
blocks.zh: 如果上述三种情形中各自对应的函数 $\phi$, $\psi$, $\bm{F}$ 属于 $C^k$ 类 (解析), 则称曲面属于 $C^k$ 类, $k\geq1$ (解析). 隐函数定理表明, 这三个定义在局部等价. 因而, 必要时重新编号坐标后, 可假设解析曲面由 $x_n=\psi(x_1,\ldots,x_{n-1})$ 给出, 其中 $\psi$ 解析. 现在令 $i\leq n-1$ 时 $y_i=x_i$, 并令 $y_n=x_n-\psi(x_1,\ldots,x_{n-1})$. 在新坐标下, 初始曲面为 $y_n=0$. 因此, 以下假设初始曲面是平面 $x_n=0$.

blocks.en: In reducing the equations, we shall sometimes have to differentiate equations with respect to $x_n$. We note that after such a differentiation, the plane $x_n=0$ remains a noncharacteristic surface of the new system. Moreover, if the differentiated equation is satisfied everywhere and the original equation is satisfied at $x_n=0$, then the original equation is satisfied everywhere. That is, whenever we differentiate an equation with respect to $x_n$, we shall view the original equation as a constraint which has to be satisfied by the initial data for the new system.
blocks.zh: 化简方程时, 有时必须将方程对 $x_n$ 求导. 注意, 这样求导以后, 平面 $x_n=0$ 仍是新方程组的非特征曲面. 此外, 如果求导后的方程处处成立, 且原方程在 $x_n=0$ 时成立, 那么原方程也处处成立. 即每当将方程对 $x_n$ 求导时, 都把原方程看作新方程组的初始数据必须满足的约束.
